question: What is the dumbest lie you ever told that completely spiraled?
story: I pretended to speak fluent Italian in a job interview, and they hired me specifically to run the Italy account. I had put conversational Italian on my resume the way everyone puts proficient in Excel. Nobody had ever asked about it. Then the hiring manager looked up, smiled, and said the Milan team would be thrilled. I nodded. I said grazie. That was most of my vocabulary. For five weeks I survived on a translation app, moved every call to email only, and blamed my microphone twice. At night I studied real Italian like a man training for a fight. Here is the part that ruined me. They flew me to Milan. I confessed in the airport parking lot, fully expecting to be fired on foreign soil. My boss stared at me and said thank God, because he did not speak it either. He had been using the same app. We got dinner. I still work there.
